body.name: Gaussian--Wishart deficiency-transfer handle
body.construction: Start from the exact Gaussian sufficient statistics consisting of the \(L\) independent block means, the donor-only post mean, and the pre and post residual scatter matrices; center them in the chart \(\xi\), separate parameter-free ancillary rotations, and construct parameter-independent randomization kernels whose uniform total-variation deficiencies vanish on \(\mathcal U\).
